results.raw_hits_note: Approximate count of postings individually keyword-matched and evaluated against the 3 filters, summed across the 3 parallel collection forks' per-source 'keyword hits of X reqs' figures. Several thousand more reqs were scanned in bulk at board-level (e.g. Cloudflare 451, Datadog 402/410(Elastic), Okta 388, Zscaler 350, Crusoe 341, Palantir 302, Canonical 314, GitLab 236, Leidos ~118, Octopus/Kraken 168, Wiz 123, Hut8 51, Garner Health 67) without every individual JD being opened, so this figure undercounts true board-level scan volume (~4,300 reqs touched across all 3 slices).
results.collection_method_note: Three collection forks ran in parallel this run, each scoped to a disjoint slice of resources/sources.md, mirroring the 2026-10-26 approach: (1) cloud-native tech + Seattle-area majors, (2) energy-sector + Palantir/Leidos, (3) newly-formalized/new-ATS/promising-leads/aggregators + LinkedIn. Each fork performed its own Step 3.5 live-URL validation inline and did not write any files or commit; the orchestrating main thread ran a Step 6 re-validation on the 5 top picks via direct curl against ATS JSON APIs, compiled, curated for quality (dropped 1 manager-tier role), wrote the report/log, updated resources/sources.md, and committed.

token_usage.note: Exact figures for all 3 collection forks, taken directly from their completion notifications. Main-thread usage is not measurable precisely for this run; proxy below.

main_thread_tool_calls_estimate.note: Main thread (orchestrator) made 5 curl calls to re-validate the top 5 picks' ATS JSON APIs directly (Step 6 spot-check) rather than independently re-collecting; all primary collection/filtering/Step-3.5 validation was performed by the 3 forks above. Main thread also read sources.md/workflow/prior logs, compiled/curated 12 qualifying roles down to 11, wrote the report/log, edited resources/sources.md, and handled the dashboard update and commit.

timing.step3_3.5_filter_and_validation_minutes_: done inline during collection by each fork, not separately timed
timing.note: step2 wall-clock time approximated from the longest-running fork's duration_ms (~313s); the 3 forks ran concurrently rather than sequentially, so this is far less than the sum of their individual durations.
